excerpt.zh: 星海帝国将会开启星系的一个黄金时代，而你们这些叛徒却弃之而去。那就随你们便吧，傻子们！
excerpt.en: The Galactic Imperium was the beginning of a golden age for the galaxy, and yet you traitors chose to throw it all away. Have it your way then, fools!

texts.zh: 星海帝国将会开启星系的一个黄金时代，而你们这些叛徒却弃之而去。那就随你们便吧，傻子们！
texts.en: The Galactic Imperium was the beginning of a golden age for the galaxy, and yet you traitors chose to throw it all away. Have it your way then, fools!

texts.zh: 够了！这个星系不配拥有我们打算创造的辉煌明天。就让帝国这么烧毁吧！让星系再次堕落到无政府和混乱的状态吧！
texts.en: Enough! This galaxy does not deserve the shining future we were building. Let the Imperium burn, then! Let the galaxy descend into anarchy and chaos once more!

texts.zh: 我们只是想为星系带来秩序和稳定，但也许混乱才是不可避免的宿命。你们赢了，叛军们！我们会让出帝位的。
texts.en: We wanted only to bring order and stability to the galaxy, but perhaps chaos is inevitable in the end. Victory is yours, rebels! We shall abdicate the throne.

texts.zh: [From.GetRulerTitle]会投降的。我们没能成功预测你们的真实背叛程度，如今星系必须为此付出代价。
texts.en: The [From.GetRulerTitle] will yield. We failed to predict the true depth of your treachery, and now the galaxy must pay the price.
